title: Jesus... I'm Just Passing Time This Season. 🍂
topic: he coasts through his waiting season passing time, scrolling till sleep, with nothing he is getting ready for

bible.text: And the glory of the LORD shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I'm just passing time this season. 🍂

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Nothing's moving, so I stopped getting ready. I scroll till sleep.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: What's coming doesn't need your schedule. It needs your readiness.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Ready for what? I can't even see it yet.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: The watchful keep their lamps filled even in the wait. Readiness is yours to keep.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: This season isn't dead time. It's the room getting ready.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone coasting through their waiting season. 🍂
